jurisdictions_federation.a_box_s_role_is: A box's role is the set of channels it has established — each qualified, requested, approved, and joined independently. Self-asserted channels are the operator's own infra choice; governed channels route through the mesh's dual-meter consent (the operator board, or a seated government).
jurisdictions_federation.adopt_this_inst: Adopt this instance into an existing cluster as a read-only mirror of its public records — authoritative for nothing. With a join key it is admitted at once; without one, a request is queued for the host operator to vouch.
jurisdictions_federation.approving_an_ad: Approving an adoption admits a read-only mirror (authoritative for nothing). Read-write is a separate governed grant — decided by the jurisdiction's standing government (Art. V §7) or, where there is none, the de-facto operator board — not a console click.

jurisdictions_federation.each_request_s_: Each request's live consent state. Approve runs the bootstrap operator-board attestation (Meter A) then ratifies; a seated government approves through its supermajority vote (Meter B). Meter C is the co-affected peers' unanimity for a channel that acts under a peer's subtree.

jurisdictions_federation.read_write_is_n: Read-write is not granted by joining. After you are a mirror, you submit a read-write request; the host's government must approve it by a supermajority of your jurisdiction's residents and a supermajority of constituent jurisdictions (Art. V §7). Only then does authority flip and the sealed operational bundle transfer.

Read-write is not granted by joining. This sends a petition to the host; its government must approve it by a supermajority of your jurisdiction's residents and a supermajority of constituent jurisdictions (Art. V §7). Only then does authority flip and the sealed operational bundle transfer. This instance stays authoritative for nothing until then.
jurisdictions_federation.sign_in_as_oper: Sign in as operator to discover, handshake, and probe peers — or use the terminal: php artisan mesh:gates, mesh:doctor <peer>.
jurisdictions_federation.the_host_s_publ: The host's public records — always pulled (this is what mirroring means).
jurisdictions_federation.the_operator_s_: The operator's readiness checklist — green is ready, amber a step not yet done, red a hard blocker. Pair with a peer probe (below) to prove the two-way datapath before the rig's certification gates.
jurisdictions_federation.the_peer_mesh_a: The peer mesh and the Full-Faith-&-Credit record. Peers authenticate by Ed25519 signature; every synced tail is verified against the peer's chain before it is applied, and a record for a jurisdiction this instance is authoritative for is never overwritten.
jurisdictions_federation.this_instance_i: This instance is a read-only mirror of host {shortId} (state: {membership_state}). It is authoritative for nothing and accepts no constitutional filings. Adopted {new}.
jurisdictions_federation.to_run_the_dns_: To run the DNS/TLS broker role, drop a Cloudflare DNS-edit token for each domain you'll broker. The token is stored encrypted on this box only — it never federates, never appears in any response, and can't be read back here. After this (plus lego on PATH), this box qualifies for broker.dns / broker.tls.
